newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - April 29.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - April 29.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Tuesday:

* On Monday, the Dow Jones industrial average rose 44.15 points to close at 6,783.02 ahead of the first-quarter Employment Cost Index -- a closely watched barometer of wage inflation -- due early Tuesday.
* Indonesian politicians campaigned from the far west of Sumatra to the jungles of Irian Jaya on Monday as the fight for nearly 125 million votes in May 29 general elections swung into high gear.

There were no reports of trouble in the world's fourth most populous nation of 200 million people after a smooth start to the campaign on Sunday and financial markets rebounded strongly after a pre-campaign attack of nerves last week.
* On Monday, the composite index rose 4.05 points to close at 656.53 points.
* On Tuesday, the rupiah was quoted at 2,423.25/23.75 at 0145 GMT, compared with an opening of 2,426.25/27.25.
* Finance firm Multidana following an encouraging debut on Monday.
* Timber firm Barito Pacific, property firm Duta Pertiwi, pharmaceutical firm Kalbe Farma and plantation firm London Sumatra after announcements of rises in their 1996 net profits.
* Small property firm Suryamas on a newspaper report it had formed a link-up with two foreign firms.
* Small-sized property firm Elang Realty on continued market talk that the share price was expected to continue rising in active trading on speculative demand.
